# WayOfProcessing

> Stripe as a payment system for business — connection and processing from 1.5%

WayOfProcessing helps businesses accept cards worldwide via Stripe: merchant account, checkout, payment routing, CRM and payouts. Independent service, not affiliated with Stripe, Inc.
